assets.prompt: Create one original standalone square equipment emblem for Grave Accord, a hand-painted 2D gothic fantasy action game. The emblem is for Ranger Nela Venn, a former water survey assistant. Use a clean hand-inked outline, broad matte gouache shapes, three strong value groups, authentic dark ash wood, muted river-reed green, warm pewter brass, cream fletch and no ornamental filigree. Make the design readable as a 32-pixel inventory icon. Use a single centered composition with complete edges and a generous 10 percent clear alpha margin all around. Real alpha transparency on the entire background. No scene, badge border, backdrop, cast shadow, extra loose parts, typography, writing, runes, glow or smoke. Subject is a compact curved ash shortbow in the middle of a deliberate draw with one short cream-fletched arrow laid across its string. Angle the bow diagonally within the square. Keep the body and string separated by a broad clear pocket so the bow reads cleanly.
